subject: Request: temporary auto-fallback & pinned-version allowance for Averna rollout
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary auto-fallback & pinned-version allowance for Averna rollout

Team —

Averna (RDW-2319) is planning a phased A/B launch next week that will route ~30% of traffic to a new quantized variant. They’ve asked us to enable an automatic fallback mechanism that would:

- detect regression signals (latency P95 > 350ms OR error-rate > 1.2% over a 5m window)
- automatically switch traffic to the last stable pinned model (previous variant) and pin that version for the duration of the window

This is outside normal rollout policy (we usually require manual approval to pin during canaries). Customer wants the fallback to be automatic to meet their internal SLA obligations. They’re also asking for a documented carve-out on uptime SLA for the first 30 days of the rollout.

As this lives at the intersection of SRE, Product, and Sales, I’m asking for an internal exception: authorization to enable auto-fallback + temporary SLA carve-out (30 days) for this specific rollout. Key asks:

1) SRE: confirm failover thresholds and rollback mechanics (telemetry, cooldowns, hit-rates).
2) Product: agree on telemetry gating and release window guardrails.
3) CS/AM: confirm customer compensation ask and communication plan.

I’ve attached a draft playbook (rollout_playbook_v1.pdf) and a short spreadsheet with proposed SLA notes.

Aim to have a decision today so we can finalize the Averna deployment plan.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

ATTACHMENTS: rollout_playbook_v1.pdf (PDF), sla-exception-summary.xlsx (XLSX)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary auto-fallback & pinned-version allowance for Averna rollout

Marissa —

I reviewed the proposed criteria and put together a conservative auto-fallback flow that SRE can own if leadership approves the exception:

- Primary triggers (5-minute sliding window):
  * P95 latency increase > 30% relative to baseline AND absolute P95 > 350ms
  * API error rate > 1.2% (client-visible errors)
  * Token-generation timeouts above 0.5%
- Cooldown: after an automatic fallback, block re-roll for 15 minutes unless manually overridden.
- Pin behavior: when fallback occurs we will pin the stable variant and mark the active rollout as "suspended" in the console; pin remains until manual unpin or after 30d (whichever earlier).
- Telemetry: require p95, p50, error-rate, 429-rate, and model inference CPU/GPU utilization to be instrumented as primary signals.

We will also add an automated PagerDuty alert to paging channel SRE-Prod with a one-click rollback action in the console. I’ll attach a short playbook snippet to the thread (included in the PDF).

From an operational risk standpoint: automatic fallback is straightforward, but we need sign-off from Product and Sales on the SLO carve-out and customer-facing wording.

Rishi
Staff SRE, Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: sam.rivera@avernasystems.com, legal@avernasystems.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary auto-fallback & pinned-version allowance for Averna rollout

Thanks — looping in Averna contact so they see proposed thresholds. A couple of customer notes:

- Averna requests that the pinned model be 'read-only' for the scope of the rollout to avoid accidental promotions. Can SRE enforce a pin flag that prevents traffic changes except by authorized Redwood staff?
- They want a short credit schedule if we trigger an auto-fallback more than twice in a 7-day window. Suggested compensation: 10% credit on consumed tokens for that billing period, capped at $10k.

Sam — is the credit range acceptable? If not, propose desired remedy and we’ll route to Finance.

Grace
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Sam Rivera <sam.rivera@avernasystems.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: legal@avernasystems.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary auto-fallback & pinned-version allowance for Averna rollout

Grace —

Thank you for the clarity. Read-only pin sounds good. Regarding compensation: Averna is comfortable with the 10% credit up to $10k if the fallback occurs more than twice in a rolling 7-day window. We’d like the carve-out window on the uptime SLA explicitly documented (30 days) and recorded in the deployment notes.

We prefer the fallback to be automated to avoid decision latency on our side when the customer-facing app is in production.

— Sam
Head of Platform Engineering, Averna Systems

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary auto-fallback & pinned-version allowance for Averna rollout

I’m fine approving a scoped exception provided we gate the rollout with an extra telemetry gate and make the pining rule immutable for external users:

- Add pre-rollout synthetic workloads for 24 hours to validate latency distribution.
- Require two green reads (30m apart) from the canary telemetry dashboard before moving to 30% traffic.
- Implement the read-only pin flag; only Staff SRE or Product Ops can remove the pin.
- SLA carve-out: 30 days, noted in the deployment audit trail; we’ll commit to the compensation terms Grace outlined.

Also add the dashboard link to the deployment notes: https://redwood.company/dashboards/rdw-2319-telemetry

Aditya
Director, Product — Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: dylan.brooks@redwood.com, sam.rivera@avernasystems.com, legal@avernasystems.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 14:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary auto-fallback & pinned-version allowance for Averna rollout

Perfect — thank you all. Summary / decision:

- Exception approved: enable automatic fallback to the last stable variant with an enforced read-only pin after fallback.
- Triggers: P95 > 350ms OR error-rate > 1.2% (5m window) OR timeout spike > 0.5% as per SRE playbook.
- Cooldown & pin: 15m cooldown; pin only removable by Staff SRE/Product Ops.
- SLA carve-out: 30 days for this rollout; compensation as agreed (10% token credit up to $10k on >2 fallbacks in 7d).
- Preconditions before enabling: 24h synthetic validation, two green telemetry reads 30m apart.

Action items:
- Rishi/Dylan: implement the read-only pin + one-click rollback and add PagerDuty hook (today).
- Grace/Finance: finalize credit mechanics in billing system and confirm contract amendment (today).
- Aditya: update deployment gating in console and add audit note (today).
- Marissa: send named confirmation to Averna and attach the updated playbook + audit link.

I’ll follow up once the playbook reflects the final thresholds.

Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
